source_table: NATO, Defence Expenditure of NATO Countries (2014–2026), Table 7: Military personnel
frequency: annual (published each June/July with NATO's defence-expenditure release)
unit: thousands of military personnel; per 1,000 population
transformations: Table 7 of the NATO workbook, the eleven NATO members of the peer group
per 1,000 population = personnel / World Bank SP.POP.TOTL × 1,000 (the latest population carried forward for NATO's estimate years)
years beyond 2026 dropped; `estimate` flags NATO's estimate years
notes: NATO definition: peacetime strength of military personnel, excluding trained reserves held at high readiness. Not the same count as DND's Regular Force.
